meta.licenseNote: Government statistics reused with attribution (GODL). Commercial tracker figures are derived headline facts with attribution, not republished tables.
notes: HEADCOUNT METHOD (modelled, not published): no source publishes per-role headcounts. Canonical headcounts are workforce-share allocations scaled to the NASSCOM FY26 workforce of 6.0M: rich jobs as weights where a rich record exists, else site headcount rescaled by 4,970,000/10,805,000 (0.46); the rich AI/ML record (160K) is split 180:220 between AI Engineer and ML Engineer; normalised to exactly 6,000,000. Do not cite a per-role headcount as a published fact.
AI ENGINEER HEADCOUNT UNRESOLVED: the old 180K (site) vs 160K (rich, combined AI/ML) gap has no published resolution; the modelled allocation above is the documented choice.

SALARY METHOD: site/rich pairs agreeing within 1 LPA use their mean; disagreeing pairs use the midpoint with min/max preserved (basis 'band-mid'). Randstad level figures are benchmarks only, never silent overwrites — except SDE (all levels), which uses the Randstad mid-level 17.27 LPA because the old site 16 / rich 18 bracket it. Randstad 'junior' is NOT labelled 'fresher' (level definitions unconfirmed). Fresher pay uses foundit GCC entry (5.4–10.2 LPA) and TeamLease GCC 0–2 yr medians.

54% GROWTH ATTRIBUTION: 54% is the combined Naukri AI/ML YoY print (Aug 2025). It stays on Generative AI / LLM Engineer and AI Agent Developer, the two records that carried it; AI Engineer is 41% and ML Engineer 35% (2025 site values). It is NOT copied onto both AI/ML records.

CITIES: gccCenters are shares of the NASSCOM–Zinnov total 2,117, rescaled from the old city splits (which summed 2,975) by largest remainder. City salary/growth are the old blended site figures; Randstad level-specific city figures are NOT comparable and live only in macro.randstadBenchmarks.
OUTLOOK_DESC THRESHOLDS (verified from shipped root data): Very Fast >= 15, Fast >= 8, Moderate >= 0, Slow Decline < 0. The design doc's guessed >= 30/>= 10 thresholds were wrong against the data.

INDICES: Naukri and foundit are parallel series, never blended or averaged. Naukri counts new listings + recruiter searches on Naukri.com; foundit counts online postings on its platform. They routinely diverge (Jul 2026: Naukri +5% vs foundit -12%; Sep 2026: +2% vs -11%). Oct-2026 Naukri YoY is flattered by the Oct-2025 Diwali base (index fell MoM 3,053 -> 2,836).

PLFS: quarterly CWS figures (LFPR 55.5% etc.) must not be mixed with the annual usual-status figure or CMIE. Revamped Jan-2025 series; clean trend window Apr 2025 -> present. Root occupations are the PLFS SAMPLE (123,888), not population employment.
EPFO: closed historical series only (Apr 2018–Sep 2025). Only Jun + Jul 2025 monthly points are baked in; the full series is not republished here.
AI TALENT DEMAND 2027 (1.25M): kept at its old value with its original 2022 vintage — no fresh 2026 restatement was found (UNVERIFIED for an update).
DOMESTIC REVENUE $69B is derived (315 - 246) and labelled as such in the dossier; Wikipedia's SR2026 summary states the same figure.
